body:
Goal: replace placeholders for website/content/docs/guides/{walkthrough,writing-plans,sweeps,sidecar-dashboard,review,operating-tips,headless-and-mcp}.mdx per spec §4.

Content requirements (spec §6 rows): walkthrough rewritten from docs/execution-example.md with C5, C27 (agb/t1, .worktrees/agb-t1, real tier candidates, report keys, sequential rebase-first merges, agb plan spec.md <repo>); writing-plans (plan.json, sizing, edges); sweeps (sweep and recursive modes; "Known issue (T-CODE-FIXES-AUDIT item 1)" for --project); sidecar-dashboard C16, C3 (link reference/security for the auth note); review C11; operating-tips C24 ("Known issue (T-CODE-FIXES-AUDIT item 7)" for the AGB_ALLOW_DIRTY warning text); headless-and-mcp (slash-command model, print-mode residual risk, MCP server). Remove placeholder: true from each.

This is a docs ticket: do not edit code or bundles — git diff --quiet origin/main -- lib bin mcp hooks sidecars scripts dist vendor; echo $? must print 0 (AC3). Do not edit AGENTS.md (AC23) or anything under .github/ (AC27). Do not hardcode test or dependency counts (N6). Every claim you write about behavior must be re-read in source at tag v1.0.0; record claim ids from spec §6 in the page frontmatter `claims:` and link each with a https://github.com/voodootikigod/antigravity-booster/blob/v1.0.0/<path>#L<n> permalink whose link text is the id, e.g. [C4](...) (D11). If code disagrees with §6, code wins; say which row was wrong in the PR description.

Context: repo antigravity-booster (agb), plugin v1.0.0. Spec: .adlc/specs/docs-site.md (revision 3: Vercel hosting, default Next.js server output) — read it first; section references below point into it. Use Node >= 22.19.0. Work on a branch off origin/main; never push to or merge into main (merge is the owner's decision).

Hard constraints: never modify .adlc/config.json (including acknowledgedNewRailBypass / trustedCodeownersAttested), lib/lock.mjs, lib/gates.mjs or CODEOWNERS (these are this ticket's rails). 

Base / prerequisites: website/ does not exist at origin/main 4864376. Start only after T-DOCS-GEN is merged to main, then branch off the updated origin/main (not 4864376). If it is not merged yet, stop and report; do not scaffold or create check scripts yourself. 
Resolved ambiguities:
- Claims per page: walkthrough C5, C27; sidecar-dashboard C16, C3; review C11 (only the parts a guide needs: repo arg default and how to run review; flags belong to cli pages); operating-tips C24. writing-plans, sweeps, headless-and-mcp carry no ids but still permalink behavior statements.
- Links: reference/security as `/docs/reference/security`.
- walkthrough: keep the narrative and commands of docs/execution-example.md, replace every fact that differs from v1.0.0 code.
- operating-tips: quotas/pool drain (lib/pools.mjs), blocked tickets (lib/scheduler.mjs), dirty-repo rule (AGB_ALLOW_DIRTY) with the item 7 callout.
- headless-and-mcp: slash-command model from commands/ and plugin.json; print-mode residual risk from SECURITY.md and lib/agy.mjs; MCP tools via a link to /docs/reference/mcp-tools.

Conventions (apply to every page you write):
- Frontmatter `claims:` is a YAML list of id strings, e.g. `claims: [C4, C21]`. Pages with no §6 row assigned omit `claims:`. Other behavior statements on any page still get a blob/v1.0.0/<path>#L<n> permalink with descriptive link text (no id). One permalink per claim id is the minimum; add more when one id covers several facts on different lines.
- Rows citing only a file (no line) mean: find the line yourself at v1.0.0 (`git show v1.0.0:<path> | grep -n ...`).
- A fact that landed after v1.0.0 (e.g. CI rails-guard reading .adlc/tickets/, #87, commit a99b3cd, not an ancestor of v1.0.0) is linked at blob/a99b3cd/... instead, and the PR description says so. Do not revert docs to pre-#87 behavior.
- Known-issue markup: `<Callout type="warn" title="Known issue (T-CODE-FIXES-AUDIT item N)">one-paragraph description</Callout>` (fumadocs-ui default MDX component; the title text is exact).
- Historical markup: the first body element is `<Callout type="info" title="Historical, superseded">...</Callout>`.
- Internal links: root-relative, e.g. `/docs/reference/security` (no basePath; the site is served at the Vercel domain root). Repo files outside website/: https://github.com/voodootikigod/antigravity-booster/blob/main/<path> (no #L on blob/main links).
- Reading rail files (lib/gates.mjs, lib/lock.mjs) for evidence is allowed; editing them is not.
- Spec errors: never edit .adlc/specs/docs-site.md; list each wrong §6 row (and what code says) in the PR description.
- Content source order: code at v1.0.0, then the root doc named in §4/§5 at origin/main. Depth: cover every bullet in §4 for the page; done = those bullets covered with evidence and all checks pass.

Operational notes:
- Run commands from the repo root; lines beginning `cd website &&` run in a subshell, e.g. `(cd website && npm ci)`.
- `npm test` is the required gate. `unshare -r -n npm test` is informational: run it if user namespaces are available and paste the output; if unsupported, say so. `cd website && npm ci` needs network and is not run under unshare.
- AC30 `gate-manifest record` writes .adlc/manifest.jsonl, which is untracked at 4864376: do not commit it; paste the `verify` output. If record fails for environmental reasons (e.g. missing ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY), paste the error; it is an audit gate and does not block the PR (AGENTS.md degrade rule).
- The follow-up chore PR touches only .adlc/tickets/ and .adlc/ticket-archive/ (ticket complete/archive); it is not part of this ticket's scope.

Verification (run each, show output in the PR description):
- npm test (root suite passes; spec AC1, also try: unshare -r -n npm test)
- git diff --quiet origin/main -- .adlc/config.json; echo $?   -> 0 (AC29)
- npx adlc rails-guard --base origin/main --rails lib/lock.mjs --rails lib/gates.mjs --rails .adlc/config.json --rails CODEOWNERS; echo $?   -> 0 (AC22)
- npm test && npx adlc gate-manifest record tests --ticket T-DOCS-GUIDES && npx adlc gate-manifest verify; echo $?   -> 0 (AC30)

- cd website && npm ci && npm run build && npm run check:site; echo $?   -> 0 (AC8, AC9; check:site starts next start on 127.0.0.1 and stays offline)
- cd website && npm run lint:links; echo $?   -> 0
- node website/scripts/check-ia.mjs; echo $?   -> 0 (AC13)
- node website/scripts/check-all.mjs; echo $?   -> 0 (includes gen --check, stale claims, evidence, known issues)
- node website/scripts/check-stale-claims.mjs && node website/scripts/check-evidence.mjs; echo $?   -> 0 (AC15, AC17)

Finish: open a PR (not merged by you). After merge, in a follow-up chore PR, run npx adlc ticket complete T-DOCS-GUIDES --write --authorize then npx adlc ticket archive T-DOCS-GUIDES --write --authorize (AC31). Archive this ticket after merge.
title: Write the Guides pages
